desc: A 6-MOA dot provides faster target acquisition and better visibility, making it ideal for self-defense and high-stress situations. A larger dot improves presentation consistency and target alignment, perfect for rapid engagements from the holster. Effortless battery replacement without removing the optic ensures hassle-free re-zeroing. A high-end CR1620 battery offers easy access while maintaining steady performance. Fitting directly to your optics-ready slides, the compact optic delivers exceptional compatibility, ensuring seamless integration across a multitude of builds. The motion sensor activates Osight K at the slightest movement and powers down after 3 minutes of inactivity to conserve battery.
